title: Smooth Scroll
description: Anchor links should scroll smoothly to target section
do_dont: do:Use scroll-behavior: smooth on html element dont:Jump directly without transition

title: Sticky Navigation
description: Fixed nav should not obscure content
do_dont: do:Add padding-top to body equal to nav height dont:Let nav overlap first section content

title: Active State
description: Current page/section should be visually indicated
do_dont: do:Highlight active nav item with color/underline dont:No visual feedback on current location

title: Back Button
description: Users expect back to work predictably
do_dont: do:Preserve navigation history properly dont:Break browser/app back button behavior

title: Deep Linking
description: URLs should reflect current state for sharing
do_dont: do:Update URL on state/view changes dont:Static URLs for dynamic content

title: Breadcrumbs
description: Show user location in site hierarchy
do_dont: do:Use for sites with 3+ levels of depth dont:Use for flat single-level sites

title: Excessive Motion
description: Too many animations cause distraction and motion sickness
do_dont: do:Animate 1-2 key elements per view maximum dont:Animate everything that moves

title: Duration Timing
description: Animations should feel responsive not sluggish
do_dont: do:Use 150-300ms for micro-interactions dont:Use animations longer than 500ms for UI

title: Reduced Motion
do_dont: do:Check prefers-reduced-motion media query dont:Ignore accessibility motion settings

title: Loading States
do_dont: do:Use skeleton screens or spinners dont:Leave UI frozen with no feedback

title: Hover vs Tap
description: Hover effects don't work on touch devices
do_dont: do:Use click/tap for primary interactions dont:Rely only on hover for important actions

title: Continuous Animation
do_dont: do:Use for loading indicators only dont:Use for decorative elements

title: Transform Performance
description: Some CSS properties trigger expensive repaints
do_dont: do:Use transform and opacity for animations dont:Animate width/height/top/left properties

title: Easing Functions
do_dont: do:Use ease-out for entering ease-in for exiting dont:Use linear for UI transitions

title: Z-Index Management
description: Stacking context conflicts cause hidden elements
do_dont: do:Define z-index scale system (10 20 30 50) dont:Use arbitrary large z-index values

title: Overflow Hidden
description: Hidden overflow can clip important content
do_dont: do:Test all content fits within containers dont:Blindly apply overflow-hidden

description: Fixed elements can overlap or be inaccessible
do_dont: do:Account for safe areas and other fixed elements dont:Stack multiple fixed elements carelessly
code_good: Fixed nav + fixed bottom with gap

title: Stacking Context
do_dont: do:Understand what creates new stacking context dont:Expect z-index to work across contexts

title: Content Jumping
description: Layout shift when content loads is jarring
do_dont: do:Reserve space for async content dont:Let images/content push layout around

title: Viewport Units
description: 100vh can be problematic on mobile browsers
do_dont: do:Use dvh or account for mobile browser chrome dont:Use 100vh for full-screen mobile layouts

title: Container Width
description: Content too wide is hard to read
do_dont: do:Limit max-width for text content (65-75ch) dont:Let text span full viewport width

title: Touch Target Size
description: Small buttons are hard to tap accurately
do_dont: do:Minimum 44x44px touch targets dont:Tiny clickable areas

title: Touch Spacing
description: Adjacent touch targets need adequate spacing
do_dont: do:Minimum 8px gap between touch targets dont:Tightly packed clickable elements

title: Gesture Conflicts
description: Custom gestures can conflict with system
do_dont: do:Avoid horizontal swipe on main content dont:Override system gestures

title: Tap Delay
do_dont: do:Use touch-action CSS or fastclick dont:Default mobile tap handling

title: Pull to Refresh
do_dont: do:Disable where not needed dont:Enable by default everywhere

title: Haptic Feedback
do_dont: do:Use for confirmations and important actions dont:Overuse vibration feedback

title: Focus States
description: Keyboard users need visible focus indicators
do_dont: do:Use visible focus rings on interactive elements dont:Remove focus outline without replacement

title: Hover States
do_dont: do:Change cursor and add subtle visual change dont:No hover feedback on clickable elements

title: Active States
do_dont: do:Add pressed/active state visual change dont:No feedback during interaction

title: Disabled States
do_dont: do:Reduce opacity and change cursor dont:Confuse disabled with normal state

title: Loading Buttons
description: Prevent double submission during async actions
do_dont: do:Disable button and show loading state dont:Allow multiple clicks during processing

description: Users need to know when something fails
do_dont: do:Show clear error messages near problem dont:Silent failures with no feedback

title: Success Feedback
do_dont: do:Show success message or visual change dont:No confirmation of completed action

title: Confirmation Dialogs
do_dont: do:Confirm before delete/irreversible actions dont:Delete without confirmation

title: Color Contrast
description: Text must be readable against background
do_dont: do:Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text dont:Low contrast text

description: Don't convey information by color alone
do_dont: do:Use icons/text in addition to color dont:Red/green only for error/success

title: Alt Text
do_dont: do:Descriptive alt text for meaningful images dont:Empty or missing alt attributes

title: ARIA Labels
do_dont: do:Add aria-label for icon-only buttons dont:Icon buttons without labels

title: Keyboard Navigation
do_dont: do:Tab order matches visual order dont:Keyboard traps or illogical tab order

title: Form Labels

title: Error Messages
do_dont: do:Use aria-live or role=alert for errors dont:Visual-only error indication

title: Image Optimization
do_dont: do:Use appropriate size and format (WebP) dont:Unoptimized full-size images

title: Lazy Loading
do_dont: do:Lazy load below-fold images and content dont:Load everything upfront

title: Code Splitting
do_dont: do:Split code by route/feature dont:Single large bundle

title: Caching
do_dont: do:Set appropriate cache headers dont:No caching strategy

title: Font Loading
do_dont: do:Use font-display swap or optional dont:Invisible text during font load

title: Third Party Scripts
do_dont: do:Load non-critical scripts async/defer dont:Synchronous third-party scripts

title: Bundle Size
do_dont: do:Monitor and minimize bundle size dont:Ignore bundle size growth

title: Render Blocking
do_dont: do:Inline critical CSS defer non-critical dont:Large blocking CSS files

description: Every input needs a visible label
do_dont: do:Always show label above or beside input dont:Placeholder as only label

description: Errors should appear near the problem
do_dont: do:Show error below related input dont:Single error message at top of form

do_dont: do:Validate on blur for most fields dont:Validate only on submit

title: Input Types
do_dont: do:Use email tel number url etc dont:Text input for everything

title: Autofill Support

title: Required Indicators

title: Password Visibility

do_dont: do:Use inputmode attribute dont:Default keyboard for all inputs
